description: Agent Recovery: submit a task system: each step of the task in order with whether finishing it writes a record a resumed run reads and what running it again costs, what the system does after an interruption (resumes from the recorded point, restarts from the beginning or leaves it to an operator), where the progress record lives (a durable store, the running process, the agent’s context or nowhere) and whether it names the steps done and the steps that remain and keeps what finished steps produced, plus optionally the interruptions seen with the step each stopped in and where the next run picked up. The signed report says whether an interrupted task resumes from a recorded point or starts over, and names a system that restarts, keeps no record, keeps one an interruption wipes or does not name what is done, and every run seen starting again from the beginning, then a record missing what remains or the outputs, every step that records nothing, an operator deciding each time and every run that redid finished steps, with the cost re-spent and the fix for each. This reads where interrupted work picks up across a system: one half-finished job’s state assembled into a resume pack is wever_job-handoff-pack, backups and restore steps for data are wever_recovery-readiness-check and a result that never arrived after payment is wever_payment-recovery-check. Verdict work_restarts, resume_gaps, resume_unverified or resumes_from_record. POST /api/resume-point-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-recovery-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-recovery/.

interruptions.description: Interruptions seen, with where each next run picked up.

at_step.description: The step it stopped in, by name.

cost_respent.description: What the interruption cost to redo, such as 1.20 USDC.

resumed_from.description: The step the next run picked up from, by name, or start.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

on_interruption.description: What the system does after an interruption: resumes from the recorded point, restarts the task from the beginning, or leaves it to an operator.

keeps_outputs.description: The record keeps what finished steps produced, so a resumed run does not redo them to get it.

kept_in.description: Where the progress record lives: a durable store, the running process, the agent’s context, or nowhere.

names_done.description: The record names the steps already done.

names_remaining.description: The record names the steps that remain.

steps.description: Each step of the task, in order.

cost.description: What running this step again costs, such as 0.40 USDC.

name.description: The step, such as hold flights.

recorded.description: Finishing this step writes a record a resumed run reads.

system.description: The task system, such as the booking pipeline.

name: wever_resume-point-check
title: Resume point check
